# CLI reference

[简体中文](zh-CN/cli.md) · [Documentation index](README.md)

<!-- Generated by tools/generate_cli_docs.py. Edit CliHelp.cpp, then regenerate. -->

This reference lists every registered command and alias. Help works without a loaded
driver. Most operations require an administrator and an available KswordARK device;
a successful help check does not establish runtime support.

## Finding help

```powershell
KswordCLI.exe help
KswordCLI.exe help <family>
KswordCLI.exe help <family> <command>
KswordCLI.exe <family> help
KswordCLI.exe <family> <command> --help
```

## Argument conventions

- Numbers accept decimal or `0x` hexadecimal; the existing base-zero parser also accepts octal with a leading zero.
- Unsigned values reject negatives and overflow; they do not silently clamp to the maximum integer.
- `--flags` is a bitmask defined by the corresponding `shared/driver/` protocol.
- `--limit` bounds printed rows; `--max-*` typically bounds the driver query budget.
- Hex payloads accept one initial `0x` and whitespace, comma, colon, hyphen, or underscore separators.
  Odd digit counts, a bare `0x`, and non-hex characters are rejected.
- Hex and file forms of the same payload are mutually exclusive.

## log

Read bounded frames from the KswordARK log device.

### log

Read up to N log frames from the shared log device.

```text
KswordCLI.exe log [--max-frames N]
```

--max-frames defaults to 64.

No subcommand is used for the log family.

## process

Inspect and control process visibility, PPL, DKOM, and cross-view state.

### process terminate

Terminate one process through the driver.

```text
KswordCLI.exe process terminate --pid PID [--exit-status NTSTATUS]
```

Required: --pid. Optional: --exit-status defaults to 0xC000013A.

### process suspend

Suspend one process.

```text
KswordCLI.exe process suspend --pid PID
```

Required: --pid.

### process resume

Resume one suspended process.

```text
KswordCLI.exe process resume --pid PID
```

Required: --pid.

Pairs with process suspend; the driver prefers PsResumeProcess and falls back to Zw/NtResumeProcess.

### process set-ppl

Set the process protection level byte.

```text
KswordCLI.exe process set-ppl --pid PID --level LEVEL
```

Required: --pid, --level.

### process set-integrity

Set a process mandatory integrity label through R0.

```text
KswordCLI.exe process set-integrity --pid PID (--rid RID | --level untrusted|low|medium|medium-plus|high|system) [--flags 0xN] [--confirm]
```

Required: --pid and one integrity selector. Optional: --flags, --confirm adds UI-confirmed protocol bit.

Backed by IOCTL_KSWORD_ARK_SET_PROCESS_INTEGRITY.

### process inject-dll

Inject a DLL path through the R0 process injection protocol.

```text
KswordCLI.exe process inject-dll --pid PID --dll PATH [--flags 0xN] [--wait-thread] --confirm
```

Required: --pid, --dll, --confirm. Optional: --flags overrides request flags; --wait-thread adds wait flag.

Backed by IOCTL_KSWORD_ARK_INJECT_PROCESS with LoadLibraryW entrypoint.

### process inject-shellcode

Inject a raw shellcode blob through the R0 process injection protocol.

```text
KswordCLI.exe process inject-shellcode --pid PID --blob PATH [--flags 0xN] --confirm
```

Required: --pid, --blob, --confirm. Optional: --flags overrides request flags.

Payload is capped by KSWORD_ARK_PROCESS_INJECT_MAX_PAYLOAD_BYTES.

### process enum

Enumerate processes from R0 evidence.

```text
KswordCLI.exe process enum [--flags 0xN] [--start-pid PID] [--end-pid PID] [--limit N]
```

Optional: --flags, --start-pid, --end-pid, --limit.

### process set-visibility

Apply a process visibility action.

```text
KswordCLI.exe process set-visibility --action ACTION [--pid PID] [--flags 0xN]
```

Required: --action. Optional: --pid defaults to 0, --flags.

### process set-special-flags

Apply special process flags.

```text
KswordCLI.exe process set-special-flags --pid PID --action ACTION [--flags 0xN]
```

Required: --pid, --action. Optional: --flags.

### process dkom

Run the configured process DKOM action.

```text
KswordCLI.exe process dkom --pid PID [--action ACTION] [--flags 0xN]
```

Required: --pid. Optional: --action, --flags.

### process crossview

Compare process evidence across supported sources.

```text
KswordCLI.exe process crossview [--flags 0xN] [--start-pid PID] [--end-pid PID] [--max-nodes N] [--limit N]
```

Optional: --flags, --start-pid, --end-pid, --max-nodes, --limit.

### process detail

Query fixed R0 process runtime detail.

```text
KswordCLI.exe process detail --pid PID [--flags 0xN]
```

Required: --pid. Optional: --flags defaults to include-all.

Backed by IOCTL_KSWORD_ARK_QUERY_PROCESS_DETAIL.

### process runtime-fields

Sample bounded EPROCESS runtime fields by checked offsets.

```text
KswordCLI.exe process runtime-fields --pid PID --items id:offset:size[:flags][,id:offset:size[:flags]...] [--flags 0xN] [--hexdump]
```

Required: --pid, --items. Optional: --flags, --hexdump.

Backed by IOCTL_KSWORD_ARK_QUERY_PROCESS_RUNTIME_FIELDS; each item is bounded by KSWORD_ARK_RUNTIME_FIELD_SAMPLE_MAX_VALUE_BYTES.

## memory

Query, read, write, translate, and audit virtual/physical memory.

### memory query-va

Query virtual memory metadata for one address.

```text
KswordCLI.exe memory query-va --pid PID --address VA [--flags 0xN]
```

Required: --pid, --address. Optional: --flags.

### memory read-va

Read virtual memory bytes.

```text
KswordCLI.exe memory read-va --pid PID --address VA --bytes N [--flags 0xN] [--hexdump]
```

Required: --pid, --address, --bytes. Optional: --flags, --hexdump.

With the kernel-address read flag, --pid may be omitted.

### memory write-va

Write virtual memory bytes.

```text
KswordCLI.exe memory write-va --pid PID --address VA (--hex HEX | --data-file PATH) [--flags 0xN]
```

Required: --pid, --address, and exactly one payload option. Optional: --flags.

With the kernel-address write flag, --pid may be omitted.

### memory read-phys

Read physical memory bytes.

```text
KswordCLI.exe memory read-phys --address PA --bytes N [--hexdump]
```

Required: --address, --bytes. Optional: --hexdump.

### memory write-phys

Write physical memory bytes.

```text
KswordCLI.exe memory write-phys --address PA (--hex HEX | --data-file PATH) [--flags 0xN]
```

Required: --address and exactly one payload option. Optional: --flags.

### memory translate-va

Translate a virtual address to page-table evidence.

```text
KswordCLI.exe memory translate-va --pid PID --address VA [--flags 0xN]
```

Required: --pid, --address. Optional: --flags.

### memory query-pte

Query page-table entries for one virtual address.

```text
KswordCLI.exe memory query-pte --pid PID --address VA [--flags 0xN]
```

Required: --pid, --address. Optional: --flags.

### memory scan-kexec

Scan executable kernel memory evidence.

```text
KswordCLI.exe memory scan-kexec [--flags 0xN] [--max-entries N] [--start VA] [--end VA] [--limit N]
```

Optional: --flags, --max-entries, --start, --end, --limit.

### memory enum-vad

Enumerate the target process VAD tree as an independent region view.

```text
KswordCLI.exe memory enum-vad --pid PID [--start VA] [--end VA] [--cursor-vpn VPN] [--max-entries N] [--flags 0xN] [--limit N]
```

Required: --pid. Optional: --start, --end, --cursor-vpn, --max-entries, --flags, --limit.

Backed by IOCTL_KSWORD_ARK_ENUMERATE_PROCESS_VAD; profileVerified=0 means the DynData VadRoot offset is not validated for this build and the result cannot support absence inference.

### memory scan-exec-pte

Scan the target process page tables for user-space executable leaves.

```text
KswordCLI.exe memory scan-exec-pte --pid PID [--start VA] [--end VA] [--cursor VA] [--max-entries N] [--max-table-reads N] [--flags 0xN] [--limit N]
```

Required: --pid. Optional: --start, --end, --cursor, --max-entries, --max-table-reads, --flags, --limit.

Backed by IOCTL_KSWORD_ARK_SCAN_PROCESS_EXECUTABLE_PTE; reports what the processor treats as executable, independent of VAD protection.

### memory read-section-pages

Read the image section object's clean reference pages for a mapped range.

```text
KswordCLI.exe memory read-section-pages --pid PID --start VA --end VA [--cursor VA] [--max-pages N] [--flags 0xN] [--limit N]
```

Required: --pid, --start, --end. Optional: --cursor, --max-pages, --flags, --limit.

Backed by IOCTL_KSWORD_ARK_READ_IMAGE_SECTION_PAGES; a second reference source independent of the file on disk. Only prototype PTEs in the architectural valid form are resolved - transition and pagefile encodings are version specific and are reported as not resident rather than decoded, and pages are never faulted in. Set --flags 0x1 to also return the page bytes.

### memory scan-evidence

Scan kernel memory evidence rows.

```text
KswordCLI.exe memory scan-evidence [--flags 0xN] [--max-rows N] [--start VA] [--end VA] [--max-bytes N] [--max-bigpool-rows N] [--sample-bytes N] [--limit N]
```

Optional: --flags, --max-rows, --start, --end, --max-bytes, --max-bigpool-rows, --sample-bytes, --limit.

## file

Inspect files, filters, storage evidence, and file-monitor runtime state.

### file delete-path

Delete one path through the driver.

```text
KswordCLI.exe file delete-path --path PATH [--flags 0xN]
```

Required: --path. Optional: --flags.

### file query-info

Query file object and basic file metadata.

```text
KswordCLI.exe file query-info --path PATH [--flags 0xN]
```

Required: --path. Optional: --flags.

### file set-integrity

Set a file or directory mandatory integrity label through R0.

```text
KswordCLI.exe file set-integrity --path PATH (--rid RID | --level untrusted|low|medium|medium-plus|high|system) [--directory] [--flags 0xN] [--confirm]
```

Required: --path and one integrity selector. Optional: --directory, --flags, --confirm adds UI-confirmed protocol bit.

Win32/UNC paths are normalized to the driver NT path convention before IOCTL_KSWORD_ARK_SET_FILE_INTEGRITY.

### file fileobject

Alias for file query-info.

```text
KswordCLI.exe file fileobject --path PATH [--flags 0xN]
```

Required: --path. Optional: --flags.

Prints an alias banner before query-info output.

### file minifilter

Enumerate minifilter inventory rows.

```text
KswordCLI.exe file minifilter [--flags 0xN] [--max-rows N] [--limit N]
```

Optional: --flags, --max-rows, --limit.

### file section

Report that the file section alias is unsupported.

```text
KswordCLI.exe file section
```

No options.

Use section query-file-mappings --path PATH for the implemented section protocol.

### file bitlocker

Query BitLocker/FVE storage audit rows.

```text
KswordCLI.exe file bitlocker [--flags 0xN] [--max-rows N] [--max-depth N] [--volume PATH] [--limit N]
```

Optional: --flags, --max-rows, --max-depth, --volume, --limit.

### file storage

Query volume stack audit rows.

```text
KswordCLI.exe file storage [--flags 0xN] [--max-rows N] [--max-depth N] [--volume PATH] [--limit N]
```

Optional: --flags, --max-rows, --max-depth, --volume, --limit.

### file mountmgr

Query MountMgr mapping audit rows.

```text
KswordCLI.exe file mountmgr [--flags 0xN] [--max-rows N] [--max-depth N] [--volume PATH] [--limit N]
```

Optional: --flags, --max-rows, --max-depth, --volume, --limit.

### file filesystem

Query filesystem integrity audit rows.

```text
KswordCLI.exe file filesystem [--flags 0xN] [--max-rows N] [--max-depth N] [--volume PATH] [--limit N]
```

Optional: --flags, --max-rows, --max-depth, --volume, --limit.

### file monitor-control

Control file monitor runtime state.

```text
KswordCLI.exe file monitor-control --action ACTION [--operation-mask 0xN] [--pid PID] [--flags 0xN]
```

Required: --action. Optional: --operation-mask, --pid, --flags.

### file monitor-drain

Drain file monitor events.

```text
KswordCLI.exe file monitor-drain [--max-events N] [--flags 0xN]
```

Optional: --max-events, --flags.

### file monitor-status

Query file monitor runtime status.

```text
KswordCLI.exe file monitor-status
```

No options.

## kernel

Inspect SSDT, hooks, driver objects, CPU, physical layout, CID, and IPC state.

### kernel ssdt

Enumerate SSDT entries.

```text
KswordCLI.exe kernel ssdt [--flags 0xN] [--limit N]
```

Optional: --flags, --limit.

### kernel shadow-ssdt

Enumerate shadow SSDT entries.

```text
KswordCLI.exe kernel shadow-ssdt [--flags 0xN] [--limit N]
```

Optional: --flags, --limit.

### kernel scan-inline-hooks

Scan inline hook evidence.

```text
KswordCLI.exe kernel scan-inline-hooks [--flags 0xN] [--max-entries N] [--module NAME] [--limit N]
```

Optional: --flags, --max-entries, --module, --limit.

### kernel enum-iat-eat-hooks

Enumerate IAT/EAT hook evidence.

```text
KswordCLI.exe kernel enum-iat-eat-hooks [--flags 0xN] [--max-entries N] [--module NAME] [--limit N]
```

Optional: --flags, --max-entries, --module, --limit.

### kernel patch-inline-hook

Patch or restore an inline hook using bounded byte evidence.

```text
KswordCLI.exe kernel patch-inline-hook --mode MODE --function VA (--expected-hex HEX | --expected-file PATH) [--restore-hex HEX | --restore-file PATH] [--flags 0xN]
```

Required: --mode, --function, and expected payload. Optional: restore payload, --flags.

Hex and file payload forms are mutually exclusive per payload.

### kernel query-driver-object

Query one DriverObject and device chain.

```text
KswordCLI.exe kernel query-driver-object --driver NAME [--flags 0xN] [--max-devices N] [--max-attached N] [--limit N]
```

Required: --driver. Optional: --flags, --max-devices, --max-attached, --limit.

### kernel query-driver-integrity

Query driver integrity evidence rows.

```text
KswordCLI.exe kernel query-driver-integrity [--driver NAME] [--module-base VA] [--flags 0xN] [--max-rows N] [--max-idt-vectors N] [--max-devices N] [--max-attached N] [--limit N]
```

Optional: --driver, --module-base, --flags, --max-rows, --max-idt-vectors, --max-devices, --max-attached, --limit.

### kernel force-unload-driver

Force an unload path for one driver.

```text
KswordCLI.exe kernel force-unload-driver --driver NAME [--module-base VA] [--timeout-ms N] [--flags 0xN]
```

Required: --driver. Optional: --module-base, --timeout-ms, --flags.

### kernel query-cpu

Query CPU hardware summary.

```text
KswordCLI.exe kernel query-cpu
```

No options.

### kernel query-phys-layout

Query physical memory layout summary.

```text
KswordCLI.exe kernel query-phys-layout
```

No options.

### kernel cid

Enumerate CID table evidence.

```text
KswordCLI.exe kernel cid [--flags 0xN] [--max-entries N] [--max-visits N] [--start-cid CID] [--end-cid CID] [--limit N]
```

Optional: --flags, --max-entries, --max-visits, --start-cid, --end-cid, --limit.

### kernel object-summary

Query object header/type/counter summary for CID or object evidence.

```text
KswordCLI.exe kernel object-summary --target-kind KIND [--cid CID] [--object ADDRESS] [--flags 0xN]
```

Required: --target-kind. Optional: --cid, --object, --flags.

Backed by IOCTL_KSWORD_ARK_QUERY_KERNEL_OBJECT_SUMMARY.

### kernel ipc

Query IPC summary for a process/handle context.

```text
KswordCLI.exe kernel ipc [--flags 0xN] [--pid PID] [--handle HANDLE] [--max-entries N]
```

Optional: --flags, --pid, --handle, --max-entries.

### kernel callbacks

Alias for callback inventory.

```text
KswordCLI.exe kernel callbacks [--flags 0xN] [--max-entries N] [--limit N]
```

Optional: --flags, --max-entries, --limit.

### kernel hooks

Alias-style inline hook scan.

```text
KswordCLI.exe kernel hooks [--flags 0xN] [--max-entries N] [--module NAME] [--limit N]
```

Optional: --flags, --max-entries, --module, --limit.

## callback

Manage callback rules, pending decisions, callback inventory, and bypass PIDs.

### callback set-rules

Load callback rule bytes.

```text
KswordCLI.exe callback set-rules --blob PATH
```

Required: --blob.

### callback runtime-state

Query callback runtime state.

```text
KswordCLI.exe callback runtime-state
```

No options.

### callback monitor-start

Start callback monitor capture with named categories.

```text
KswordCLI.exe callback monitor-start [--categories LIST]
```

Optional: --categories process,thread,image,registry,object,minifilter,core,all; defaults to core.

IOCTL_KSWORD_ARK_CALLBACK_MONITOR_CONTROL; minifilter is high frequency and is not in core.

### callback monitor-stop

Stop callback monitor capture without changing existing callback rules.

```text
KswordCLI.exe callback monitor-stop
```

No options.

Backed by IOCTL_KSWORD_ARK_CALLBACK_MONITOR_CONTROL.

### callback monitor-status

Query callback monitor capture state and ring counters.

```text
KswordCLI.exe callback monitor-status
```

No options.

Backed by IOCTL_KSWORD_ARK_CALLBACK_MONITOR_QUERY.

### callback monitor-read

Read callback monitor records through an independent cursor.

```text
KswordCLI.exe callback monitor-read [--after-sequence N] [--max-records N] [--limit N]
```

Optional: --after-sequence, --max-records, --limit.

Backed by IOCTL_KSWORD_ARK_CALLBACK_MONITOR_READ; use next_sequence for the next read.

### callback wait-event

Wait for one callback event packet.

```text
KswordCLI.exe callback wait-event [--waiter-tag N]
```

Optional: --waiter-tag.

### callback answer-event

Answer one pending callback event.

```text
KswordCLI.exe callback answer-event --event-guid GUID --decision N --source-session-id N [--answered-at UTC100NS]
```

Required: --event-guid, --decision, --source-session-id. Optional: --answered-at.

### callback cancel-pending

Cancel all pending callback decisions.

```text
KswordCLI.exe callback cancel-pending
```

No options.

### callback remove

Remove a callback through an address-based public API path.

```text
KswordCLI.exe callback remove --class N --callback VA [--flags 0xN]
```

Required: --class, --callback. Object, Registry, and ETW classes are not supported by this legacy command.

### callback remove-ex

Remove an external callback with extended row identity.

```text
KswordCLI.exe callback remove-ex --class N --callback VA [--registration VA] [--raw-storage VA] [--generation N] [--identity-hash N] [--source N] [--operation-mask 0xN] [--object-type-mask 0xN] [--trust-flags 0xN] [--remove-behavior N] [--flags 0xN]
```

Object removal requires every identity field copied from one verified V3 enumeration row plus revalidation flags. Registry and ETW removal are disabled.

### callback set-minifilter-bypass-pids

Set minifilter bypass PID list.

```text
KswordCLI.exe callback set-minifilter-bypass-pids --pids PID[,PID...] [--flags 0xN]
```

Required: --pids. Optional: --flags.

### callback query-minifilter-bypass-pids

Query minifilter bypass PID list.

```text
KswordCLI.exe callback query-minifilter-bypass-pids
```

No options.

### callback enum

Enumerate callback inventory.

```text
KswordCLI.exe callback enum [--flags 0xN] [--max-entries N] [--limit N]
```

Optional: --flags, --max-entries, --limit.

## thread

Enumerate threads and compare R0/R3 thread evidence.

### thread enum

Enumerate threads.

```text
KswordCLI.exe thread enum [--flags 0xN] [--pid PID] [--limit N]
```

Optional: --flags, --pid, --limit.

### thread crossview

Compare thread evidence across supported sources.

```text
KswordCLI.exe thread crossview [--flags 0xN] [--pid PID] [--start-tid TID] [--end-tid TID] [--max-nodes N] [--limit N]
```

Optional: --flags, --pid, --start-tid, --end-tid, --max-nodes, --limit.

### thread detail

Query fixed R0 ETHREAD/KTHREAD runtime detail.

```text
KswordCLI.exe thread detail --tid TID [--pid PID] [--flags 0xN]
```

Required: --tid. Optional: --pid, --flags defaults to include-all.

Backed by IOCTL_KSWORD_ARK_QUERY_THREAD_DETAIL.

### thread runtime-fields

Sample bounded ETHREAD/KTHREAD runtime fields by checked offsets.

```text
KswordCLI.exe thread runtime-fields --tid TID [--pid PID] --items id:offset:size[:flags][,id:offset:size[:flags]...] [--flags 0xN] [--hexdump]
```

Required: --tid, --items. Optional: --pid, --flags, --hexdump.

### r0 object-types

Enumerate the kernel object-type table.

```text
KswordCLI.exe r0 object-types [--flags 0xN] [--max-entries N] [--start-index N]
```

Optional: --flags, --max-entries, --start-index.

Backed by IOCTL_KSWORD_ARK_ENUM_OBJECT_TYPE_TABLE.

### r0 win32k-timers

Query PDB-backed win32k timer evidence.

```text
KswordCLI.exe r0 win32k-timers [--flags 0xN] [--session-id N] [--pid PID] [--tid TID] [--max-entries N]
```

Optional: --flags, --session-id, --pid, --tid, --max-entries.

Backed by IOCTL_KSWORD_ARK_QUERY_WIN32K_TIMERS.

### r0 win32k-events

Query PDB-backed WinEvent-hook evidence.

```text
KswordCLI.exe r0 win32k-events [--flags 0xN] [--session-id N] [--pid PID] [--tid TID] [--max-entries N]
```

Optional: --flags, --session-id, --pid, --tid, --max-entries.

Backed by IOCTL_KSWORD_ARK_QUERY_WIN32K_EVENT_HOOKS.

## ddma

DDMA capability, bounded physical reads, and explicit self-tests.

### ddma selftest

Run the DDMA acceptance checks; every check is a refusal path, so no disk sector is written.

```text
KswordCLI.exe ddma selftest [--lba N]
```

Optional: --lba enables the ATA DMA transfer probe on that scratch sector.

Verdicts are PASS / FAIL / NOT_APPLICABLE. Missing ATA pass-through is NOT_APPLICABLE, not a failure.

### ddma probe

Enumerate disks usable for DDMA and report capability flags.

```text
KswordCLI.exe ddma probe [--lba N] [--max-disks N]
```

Optional: --lba issues a real ATA DMA read on that sector; --max-disks.

Backed by IOCTL_KSWORD_ARK_DDMA_QUERY_CAPABILITY. Without --lba it only enumerates.

### ddma read

Read physical memory through disk DMA.

```text
KswordCLI.exe ddma read --disk N --pa ADDR --lba N [--bytes N]
```

Required: --disk, --pa, --lba. Optional: --bytes (default 64, one page max).

Temporarily overwrites the scratch sectors at --lba and restores them; the range must not cross a page.
